evals.prompt: fetch BibTeX for these DOIs and write refs.bib: 10.1021/acs.jctc.1c00537, 10.1103/PhysRevLett.77.3865
evals.expected_output: refs.bib with ≥1 valid BibTeX entry, summary of fetched/failed counts, no hallucinated fields

assertions.name: refs.bib file written to outputs/
refs.bib contains ≥1 valid BibTeX entry (starts with @)
all entries have a non-empty citekey
run_log.txt reports fetched/failed/manual-needed counts

evals.prompt: run lit-bib on the provided papers.json and save bibliography to my_refs.bib
evals.expected_output: my_refs.bib with ≥2 entries (2 DOI papers + 1 arXiv paper), summary report

assertions.name: my_refs.bib or refs.bib file written to outputs/
at least 2 BibTeX entries in output file
arXiv entry present (eprint or archivePrefix field)
excluded papers (screening_status=excluded) skipped

evals.prompt: fetch BibTeX for arXiv paper 1706.03762 — it is the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need)
evals.expected_output: refs.bib with 1 arXiv-style entry containing eprint field and archivePrefix=arXiv, citekey generated

assertions.name: refs.bib written
entry has eprint and archivePrefix fields
entry has non-empty citekey

evals.prompt: /lit-bib verify literature/refs.bib — the 2026-10-21 audit flagged 14/21 entries; verify it and tell me what to do
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/verify_bibtex.py, passes the structured JSON report back with per-entry status + reasons, proposes gate actions per entry (fabricated: delete/flag for user; mismatch: correct with details.resolved metadata; unverified: ask for DOI/arXiv) — model never edits entries itself

assertions.name: statuses interpreted from status+details.reasons, not re-derived
no entries edited/deleted by the model; verify report only
proposes per-entry gate actions incl. delete for fabricated
exit 1 treated as expected when problems found, not a tooling failure
duplicate keys in report.duplicates flagged as hard exit-blocking finding

evals.prompt: verify bib — report says various2024quantifying is mismatch with key_check {expected_surname: dalton, expected_year: 2024, ok: false}. What is wrong and what do I do?
evals.expected_output: Explains key mislabel (key must contain resolved first-author surname 'dalton' + year 2024 — audit case: rename to dalton2024), distinguishes from fabricated (fields themselves match, only the key is wrong), proposes rename as gate action without editing

assertions.name: identifies key mislabel vs fabricated correctly
uses key_check.expected_surname/expected_year from report details
suggests dalton2024-style rename as gate action

evals.prompt: check refs on my in-progress bib — several entries are hand-typed without DOI or arXiv ID yet
evals.expected_output: Runs verify script; no-DOI/no-eprint entries come back unverified (provenance unverified) — reported as manual follow-up (ask user for identifiers), NOT fabricated; summary line passed through; exit 0 without --strict treated as clean-of-fabrication, --strict only when user wants hard gate

assertions.name: no-identifier entries classified unverified, not fabricated
human summary line 'Verified: N | Fabricated: N | Mismatch: N | Unverified: N' reported
uses --strict only when user demands hard gate
